# unco_plan_action (Resource)

Queues a remote `plan` action on an Unco stack at apply time, optionally delayed by 0..900 seconds.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "unco_plan_action" "example" {
  warehouse     = "sample-warehouse"
  stack         = "customs-sandbox"
  delay_seconds = 60

  triggers = {
    account_id = "123456789012"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `stack` (String) Target Unco stack name.
- `warehouse` (String) Target Unco warehouse name.

### Optional

- `delay_seconds` (Number) Delivery delay in seconds (0..900).
- `destroy` (Boolean) Whether to plan a destroy operation.
- `ref` (String) Optional source/package ref to plan.
- `targets` (List of String) Optional resource addresses to pass via `-target`.
- `triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary key/value pairs that re-trigger the plan action when changed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
